introduction.name: Lathiesh Mahendran
introduction.title: AI & Full-Stack Engineer
introduction.headline: I build AI-powered products, from the data pipeline to the user interface.
introduction.description: I'm a product engineer at Corvus, with 3+ years of experience building at early-stage startups. My work spans AI agents, retrieval systems, backend services, and full-stack applications.

about: I'm Lathiesh, an AI and full-stack engineer based in Coimbatore. I've worked closely with founders and small engineering teams, taking products from initial requirements through architecture, implementation, and production support.

At Corvus, I build research agents, company enrichment pipelines, evaluation tooling, and product features for sales intelligence. Previously, at The Yellow Network, I co-built Tia, a RAG assistant for TVS Supply Chain Solutions, and Nifo, an AI co-innovation platform.
I enjoy owning a problem end to end: understanding the data, choosing the right approach, building the experience, and improving it once it's in use.

projects.name: Corvus
projects.subtitle: AI research and company intelligence
projects.summary: Architected the multi-step agentic research pipeline behind Corvus, a sales-intelligence platform for the chemical industry, plus the data pipelines, evaluation tooling and product features around it.
projects.problem: Corvus is a 5-person AI startup building sales intelligence for the chemical industry, and I work directly with the CEO and CTO. Chemical sales research needs information about companies, their products and their facilities to be collected from many sources and brought together into useful account intelligence.
myContribution: Architected the product's multi-step agentic research pipeline: tool-using LLM agents (Vertex AI Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Exa AI) on Trigger.dev take a company name and produce a cited report on its products, facilities and operations. Stages run in parallel and pick up where they left off after a failure.

Engineered enrichment and classification pipelines over a ~200K-company dataset with Crustdata, Exa AI, Olostep, Riveter, OpenAI and Gemini, covering batch and real-time processing, entity matching and deduplication.

Built LLM evaluation harnesses (ground-truth datasets, precision/recall scoring) so model and prompt changes are benchmarked before they reach production. Brought LLM cost down with prompt caching, right-sizing models per stage, and cost telemetry.

Extended the agent harness behind the product's Claude-based AI agent (Vercel AI SDK, tool calling), working on how it manages context and persists state, and built MCP tools that give research agents access to EPA facility data.

Shipped full-stack features (FastAPI, Neon PostgreSQL, React/TypeScript, Render): PropelAuth multi-tenant auth, Google Maps/Places geospatial prospecting, a Plate.js live editor, PDF/CSV/email document pipelines, Parallel AI news monitoring and admin tooling.
Brought production error alerts to zero by setting up Slack and Grafana monitoring across services and pipelines, then fixing what it surfaced through backfills, data repairs and job recovery.
Automated engineering and data operations with Claude Code and Codex: custom agent skills, operational runbooks, and parallel sub-agent workflows that audited thousands of production records.
engineeringDecisions: Resume failed stages to avoid restarting the entire workflow.
Use prompt caching and models sized for individual stages to manage LLM cost.
Benchmark model and prompt changes before they reach production.

evidence.meaning: Companies in the enrichment/classification dataset, not customers or research reports

experience.summary: Early-stage startup building Nifo, an AI co-innovation workflow platform. I worked directly with the founder and co-built Tia and Nifo, spanning RAG, model endpoints, backend services, data pipelines, and frontend product development.
contributions: Co-built Tia from scratch with one other engineer: the RAG assistant live on tvsscs.com for TVS Supply Chain Solutions (NSE-listed). It answers visitor support questions and captures sales-qualified leads into HubSpot CRM for the sales team.
